notes.title: Painted battle fields
notes.text: All 20 terrains have new painted scenes and floor bases, with light that follows the story clock outdoors (dawn, day, dusk, night), ambient particles and live weather. Settings → Field art switches back to Classic FireRed.

notes.title: Double battle floor bases
notes.text: The second Pokémon on each side now stands on its own floor base.

notes.title: Pokémon League scene card
notes.text: The scene status card has its own Day and Night design in the Pokémon League chat themes. Catches no longer print a caption over the field.
